title: Project State
description: One project's state after a merged PR, submitted by the Intent Supervisor to POST /api/projects/{projectId}/states. The workflow script fills every field except content; content is the state itself, written as Markdown, and is stored as is.

event_id.description: Identifies this submission. Must stay the same when the same workflow run is retried, e.g. "gh-run-<github.run_id>". Used as the Firestore document ID, so it must not contain '/'.

project_id.description: Stable project identifier. Must equal {projectId} in the request URL.

source_commit_sha.description: The merge commit of the merged PR on the default branch.

base_state_id.description: The event_id of the previous accepted state. null only for the first state of a project. The server returns 409 if it is no longer the project's current state.

updated_at.description: When the state was collected. ISO 8601 with a time zone offset.

pull_request.description: The merged PR that produced this state.

generator.description: Optional. What produced content, for tracing.

content.description: The project state as Markdown. The server stores it without checking its structure.
